checks: Requested sections are absent; customer starts with 21 named vehicle models and photos, without creating stock
Pickup selector includes all 34 current provinces and cities plus the nationwide option
Every model photograph is bundled, nonempty and served successfully; no random image service is used
Brand and seat filters work across the model directory
Selecting a model with no published vehicle does not offer a fabricated quote or booking
Existing owner drafts receive the correct model image while retaining their draft state and empty uploaded-photo list
Owner form offers the same province/model choices and still uploads, saves and submits actual photos
After admin approval, customer model selection leads to the matching physical car with actual price, uploaded photo and protected address
Busy vehicles disappear from dated availability while model browsing stays available
Rental availability failure is shown explicitly without inventing availability or hiding the model directory
Legacy province names normalize on save without automatically publishing or assigning uploaded photos

build: All four Maven JAR modules built successfully with Java21

scope: Current UI integration used real Auth/Car HTTP services with H2 and a controlled Rental availability stub. PostgreSQL/Eureka checks for the previous version remain under history/v8; Docker and visual browser layout were not executed here.
